text: IMF staff view the outlook as broadly stable. Real GDP growth is projected to rise to 4.3 percent in 2025 and stabilize at around 3.5 percent in the medium term. Average annual inflation is projected to stabilize at around 3 percent over the medium term. The current account deficit is expected to average about 9 percent of GDP over the medium term, while reserve coverage reaches around 3.8 months of imports over the medium term. Staff highlight external downside risks.
